name: What is the construction process for an accessible bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the construction process for an accessible bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an in-home evaluation of your current bathroom layout, structural framing, and plumbing lines. Next, your contractor creates a layout plan that accommodates wider clear floor space, appropriate vanity heights, and barrier-free shower areas. Once selections are finalized and permits are secured, the team handles demolition, reinforces wall studs for secure grab bar placement, updates plumbing, and installs slip-resistant surfaces. Blue Lake Construction coordinates these steps through hands-on project management to ensure every fixture is installed to exact specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with an evaluation and design plan, followed by structural wall reinforcement, plumbing rough-ins, waterproof tile installation, and fixture placement.
